text: A CRC-32 check fails on a received Ethernet frame. What does the receiver do?
choices: Corrects the error using the CRC
Discards the frame silently and increments an error counter
Forwards it with an error flag set
explanation: The CRC provides detection, not correction, and Ethernet has no link-layer retransmission. The frame is discarded and a counter incremented; recovery, if any, is the transport layer's job. This is why reading interface counters is the way to find a marginal cable.
